title: 微電網孤島與併網控制
summary: 以孤島功率平衡、同步條件與轉換動態串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect island power balance, synchronization and transition dynamics through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 資源與邊界
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「資源與邊界」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop resources and boundaries through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 邊界定義：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「邊界定義」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for boundary definition.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「邊界定義」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。公共連接點決定孤島的功率邊界。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for boundary definition, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. The common coupling point defines island power boundaries. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Map inputs, loads and critical branches. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。
steps.observationEn: Map inputs, loads and critical branches.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「邊界定義」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping boundary definition verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「邊界定義」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for boundary definition; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 公共連接點決定孤島的功率邊界。
knowledge.textEn: The common coupling point defines island power boundaries.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Map inputs, loads and critical branches. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設孤島負載 500 kW，持續發電 300 kW，電池需補 200 kW；支撐 30 min 的交流能量為 100 kWh。若放電效率 0.90，需可用直流能量 111.11 kWh，未計備援 SOC 或老化。
knowledge.textEn: For island load 500 kW and generation 300 kW, a battery supplies 200 kW. Thirty minutes requires 100 kWh AC, or 111.11 kWh available DC at 0.90 discharge efficiency, before SOC reserve and aging.

quiz.question: 審查「邊界定義」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for boundary definition?
options: 公共連接點決定孤島的功率邊界。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「邊界定義」的驗證。
只調整「邊界定義」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: The common coupling point defines island power boundaries.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping boundary definition verification.
Tuning the displayed boundary definition result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 公共連接點決定孤島的功率邊界。 畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。
quiz.explanationEn: The common coupling point defines island power boundaries. Map inputs, loads and critical branches.

steps.title: 邊界定義：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「邊界定義」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for boundary definition.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。 比較差異是否符合「公共連接點決定孤島的功率邊界。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Map inputs, loads and critical branches. Compare the result against: The common coupling point defines island power boundaries. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。
steps.observationEn: Map inputs, loads and critical branches.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「邊界定義」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping boundary definition verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「邊界定義」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for boundary definition; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
